svg.title: Noise shape and the stationary cloud
svg.desc: Stationary clouds of 500 samples for SGD-like dynamics on a quadratic loss whose curvatures are 10 and 0.1 (grey contours). Left: with isotropic noise the cloud is the Gibbs law, stretched along the flat direction (variances D/h). Right: with noise covariance proportional to the Hessian and the same total size, the cloud is round.
svg.text: Noise shaped like H: a round cloud
